{"question": "What modern-day country was Tesla born in?", "sources": [{"source_id": "squad-context-aeb6da0ef272211b693c1a0a845534de30c6d0617828b8e15613bb15c188d272", "text": "Tesla was born on 10 July [O.S. 28 June] 1856 into a Serb family in the village of Smiljan, Austrian Empire (modern-day Croatia).
